values.enterprise_total: Not restated; legacy enterprise scale schedules are historical and require an explicit reconciliation before aggregation

measurement_rules.unknown: null means not established; zero means evidenced absence or explicit model allocation of none
measurement_rules.named_population: Deduplicate by person_id across every chart; named population is a source coverage count, not a payroll census.
measurement_rules.roles: Unnamed offices and role-family counts overlap establishments; never add role-register counts to J2 or enterprise totals.
measurement_rules.employment: Former, external, unconfirmed and superseded identities are excluded from current totals. Nonemployee directors remain a separate visitor demand category.
measurement_rules.workforce: Known industrial population and named employees overlap. Never add 44 named employees to the 271 industrial population or 237 J2 billets.
measurement_rules.attendance: Assigned workforce, residents, cohort peaks, shifts and maximum simultaneous attendance require explicit schedules; no authorization-to-desk equivalence.
measurement_rules.seats: Meeting/training/resident capacities are activity capacities, not additional people. Peak scenario must allocate one person once across simultaneous activities.
measurement_rules.forecast: 2027 conditional workforce is retained separately; not actual 2026 payroll, and not an automatic 2031 or 2036 forecast.
measurement_rules.support: ESS services requirement FTE and Education rotating practitioners are allocations of existing or explicitly proposed pools, not extra employees. Internal Audit and J2 remain outside ESS.

planning_basis.description: Campus designer may test full J2 authorization of 237 as a capacity envelope, with Education 35 and HQ support 28 inside that total. Core 2027 506 occupied / 591 authorized is a conditional comparison only; distributed businesses and industrial staff must not all be placed in Sacramento. 2031/2036 staffing growth is unresolved until explicitly modelled in the campus source.
